metadata.query: You MUST use the search_knowledge_base tool to search for 'What is the computational security status of the AES-256 encryption standard against brute-force attacks?'. Do NOT answer from memory under any circumstances. Tool call required.

final_answer: The AES-256 encryption standard is considered secure against brute-force attacks for a very long time, even with the most powerful computers available today. (Source: NIST Special Publication 800-38A Revision 1 (2011))
